correctness.rationale: Positive linear boxcar averaging gives the exact all-real norm as a maximum over binary indicators by coarea. The substantive external input is Lev prime cyclic majorization as restated with parity conventions in Madiman–Wang–Woo Lemma 6.3; it implies convolution of a k-set and m-arc is majorized by interval-convolution. Gini is symmetric convex, so intervals suffice. With k<=floor(p/2), m<=floor(p/2), window overlaps form level lengths c_t=m+k-2t+1 for 1<=t<=min(k,m), and the layer-cake identity gives p m k-ab²-a(a²-1)/3. The resulting two piecewise rational Gini ratios strictly increase with k to the balanced cut, giving 1-(m²-1)/(3Q). For m>p/2, complementary windows give the exact factor d/m and same balanced witnesses. This proves all odd primes>=5 and all widths 1<=m<p; nonprime cases are not claimed.
